import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxN = 70;
    static final int maxn = 50;
    static final int lim = 22;
    static final long oo = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static long[][] C = new long[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];
    static int n, m, N, mid;
    static int[] g = new int[maxN + 5];
    static List<Pair<Long, Integer>>[][] partb = new ArrayList[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
    static Map<Long, Long>[][] parta = new HashMap[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
    static long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long ans_cnt = 0;

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        U first;
        V second;
        Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void prepare() {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean chkmin(long[] a, long b) {
        if (a[0] > b) {
            a[0] = b;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean chkmax(long[] a, long b) {
        if (a[0] < b) {
            a[0] = b;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum, int n, int N, int[] g, List<Pair<Long, Integer>>[][] partb) {
        if (x == mid) {
            partb[cnta][cntb].add(new Pair<>(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp, n, N, g, partb);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp, n, N, g, partb);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs_parta(int n, int m, int N, int mid, int[] g, List<Pair<Long, Integer>>[][] partb, Map<Long, Long>[][] parta) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : parta[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    long u_x = entry.getKey();
                    long u_y = entry.getValue();
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        List<Pair<Long, Integer>> list = partb[i][j];
                        int p = lowerBound(list, new Pair<>(-u_x, -1));
                        if (p < list.size()) {
                            long val = Math.abs(u_x + list.get(p).first);
                            update(val, u_y * list.get(p).second);
                        }
                        if (p > 0) {
                            long val = Math.abs(u_x + list.get(p - 1).first);
                            update(val, u_y * list.get(p - 1).second);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k <= 1; k++) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) ++cnta;
                            else ++cntb;
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                long key = u_x + tmp;
                                long val = u_y;
                                parta[cnta][cntb].put(key, parta[cnta][cntb].getOrDefault(key, 0L) + val);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Pair<Long, Integer>> list, Pair<Long, Integer> target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).first >= target.first) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (chkmin(new long[]{ans}, val)) {
            ans_cnt = cnt;
        } else if (val == ans) {
            ans_cnt += cnt;
        }
    }

    static void work(int n, int m, int N, int mid, int[] g) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                partb[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m, 0, n, N, g, partb);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                Collections.sort(partb[i][j], Comparator.comparing(p -> p.first));
                List<Pair<Long, Integer>> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = partb[i][j].size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long cur = partb[i][j].get(k).first;
                    int cnt = 0;
                    while (k < sz && partb[i][j].get(k).first == cur) {
                        cnt += partb[i][j].get(k).second;
                        k++;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new Pair<>(cur, cnt));
                }
                partb[i][j] = tmp;
            }
        }
        bfs_parta(n, m, N, mid, g, partb, parta);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        prepare();
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        m = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        String s = br.readLine();
        N = (n + m) << 1;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - lim);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (s.charAt(i) == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= maxn; j++) {
                partb[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        work(n, m, N, mid, g);
        ans_cnt = 0;
        work(n, m, N, mid, g);
        System.out.println(ans_cnt);
    }
}
